purpose: Two-sided version of configs/tail_stretch_v1.json's v35_t1500: after the upper stretch (value + k1 x max(value - 1500, 0)), a lower stretch value + k2 x max(t2 - value, 0) with k2 fitted the same way (least squares on the other recipe months, per scope, on the upper-stretched values). The v35 stack over-predicts rows it puts at 300-900 s in every month (-1 ... -25 s). No model is fitted beyond one coefficient per scope and side.

prior_context.note: POST-HOC for the lower side: declared after an exploratory leave-one-month-out read on these same four months (disclosed): t2 = 600 / 900 / 1200 added -0.021 / -0.046 / -0.041% (mean) on top of the upper stretch, t2 = 900 better in every month (-0.009 / -0.017 / -0.057 / -0.102%), k2 about -0.035 (tracked). A per-airport k was also explored and LOST to the pooled k (-0.120% vs -0.188%), so the pooled form is kept. The upper side is unchanged from tail_stretch_v1.

scopes: as configs/tail_stretch_v1.json: untracked / tracked non-LIRF rows outside the callsign / queue layers; LIRF and anchored rows keep the control
fit: per held month, from the other three months' in-scope rows: k1 = LS of (label - control) on max(control - 1500, 0); u = control + k1 x max(control - 1500, 0); k2 = LS of (label - u) on max(t2 - u, 0). For the export, both from all four months.
candidate_semantics: value = max(u + k2 x max(t_lower - u, 0), floor) on in-scope rows (u = the upper-stretched value); upper_only reproduces tail_stretch_v1's v35_t1500 and is a code-path check (its per-month ratios must equal tail_stretch_v1's to 1e-9)
selection: Unchanged rule over the four recipe months against the v35 stack: eligible when no recipe month is worse on ALL rows, the mean ratio is at least 0.02% below 1, and every touched month's paired-day 95% interval (seed 20260928) lies below zero; lowest mean ratio among eligible.
ship: tools/export_stack.py --stretch 1500 with the lower side added, k from all four months; upload only on the user's decision.
